title: Bolivia: the highlands, unit review
goal: Review the Bolivian highlands, from Lake Titicaca to the Constitution of 2009, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: relative clauses, estar + participle, no es que… sino que, reported information, por más que

items: I can review what I learned about the Bolivian highlands, from Lake Titicaca to the Constitution of 2009.
I can use relative clauses, *estar* + participle, *no es que… sino que*, *según* and *por más que*.
I can say who says what about the coca leaf.
I can describe the high plateau and Lake Titicaca with relative clauses introduced by *que* and *quien* (review).
I can say what Potosí looks like today with *estar* + participle (review).
I can correct a wrong idea about La Paz and El Alto with *no es que… sino que…* (review).
I can say who says what about the coca leaf, using *según* and *dice que* (review).
I can grant a point and still state my main idea with *por más que* + subjunctive (review).
